description: This file contains macro definitions for implementing commit slab structures and functions for initialization, clearing, and access. It appears to be part of a memory management or commit tracking system in a C project.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with the specified stride, setting size parameters and the slab array.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a default stride of 1.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears all slabs, freeing allocated memory.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Performs a deep clear by freeing individual elements using a provided free function, then clears the slab.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit, optionally adding the slab if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit, with default behavior to add if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit without adding if missing.
